title: Monomial on a partitioned input
statement: Let $n$ and $m$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ input coordinates, let $z$ be a vector of $n$ signs, let $\pi$ map the $n$ input coordinates to the $m$ output coordinates, and let $w$ be a vector of $m$ signs. Form $R$ from those output coordinates that are the image under $\pi$ of an odd number of elements of $S$. The monomial indexed by $S$ at the vector with coordinates $z_iw_{\pi(i)}$ equals the monomial indexed by $S$ at $z$ times the monomial indexed by $R$ at $w$.
hypotheses_covered: Map $\pi$ from input to output coordinates
